BL-903 — push-sweep's push-failed log records only an attempt count and discards git's actual error — 27 consecutive failures against a remote that is provably healthy, and no way to tell why
What it solves: Sibling tickets from the same intake: BL-902 (briefing-email compose-before-
key-check, the actual restart storm) and BL-904 (cost-health sidecar's
daemonRestarts reads 0). Independent; any landing order.
Approval context: One thing to be aware of, no decision needed unless you disagree.
The intake suspected the push sweep was "likely why local `main` sat unpushed". I probed that before writing this, and the suspicion did not survive contact in the shape it was filed. The retry budget is NOT stuck: `:exhausted?` gate…
BL-903 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-903" (or "reject BL-903 <reason>") to act.
